name: Pitchline
description: Every cell picks its own pitch, so the sheet grades from open to dense with no order to it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @pick(6%, 9%, 13%, 18%), transparent @pick(6%, 9%, 13%, 18%) @pick(14%, 22%, 30%, 40%)); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @pick(6%, 9%, 13%, 18%), transparent @pick(6%, 9%, 13%, 18%) @pick(14%, 22%, 30%, 40%)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
